## Purpose
Profile details card listing location, company, contact info and social links, each with an icon. It combines the GitHub-derived `Profile` with configured `social` and `github` settings, showing skeletons while loading.

## Key concepts
- `DetailsCard` props: `profile`, `loading`, `social` (`SanitizedSocial`) and `github` (`SanitizedGithub`), types from [[src-interfaces]].
- `ListItem` renders an icon/title/value row; `OrganizationItem` renders company text.
- `isCompanyMention` / `companyLink`: a company string like `@org` (starts with `@`, no spaces) becomes a link to `https://github.com/org`.
- `getFormattedMastodonValue` splits `user@server` into display text or a `https://server/@user` link.
- Many `react-icons` (GitHub, LinkedIn, X, Mastodon, Threads, etc.) map each social field to an icon; skeletons from [[src-utils]].

## Gotchas
- Mastodon values must be in `user@server` form; the function does not validate and a missing server yields `https://undefined/@user`.
- `ListItem` always wraps the value in an `<a>`, even when `link` is undefined.
